## What's Changed
* Use webpki 0.18 to validate SNI hostname before cert selection. by @briansmith in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/106

* Validate client certificates using the id-kp-clientAuth EKU. by @briansmith in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/111
* Avoid cloning ALPN protocol in `get_alpn_protocol()`. by @briansmith in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/114

* Lower logging priority by @crawford in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/121
* Avoid "error: non-scalar cast: `T` as `f64`" errors in bench example. by @briansmith in https://github.com/rustls/rustls/pull/103
